egress.terms: NOT STATED on the product page. What is published is bandwidth shape only: 'Peak Bandwidth 1.000 MBit / Guaranteed bandwidth 300 MBit'. No traffic volume, no unlimited claim, no overage rate. This is the one number that decides whether the €1.25/TB headline is real.

limits_note: Guaranteed bandwidth is only 300 Mbit (peak 1 Gbit) — at 300 Mbit sustained the theoretical monthly ceiling is ~97 TB, so even 'unlimited' would be shaped well below Hetzner's 1 Gbit. Setup €0.00. Windows +€31/mo, CloudLinux +€12/mo.
reliability_note: Cheapest raw €/TB found in Europe, but the traffic term is unverified — do not commit without a ticket. German provider (webtropia.com / Host Europe group lineage).
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
